prediction.rationale: The clause gives the complainant an option to approach the RBI Ombudsman when no satisfactory response is received within a maximum of one month. The due-date paragraph copies the complaint day unchanged and adds one to the month; for a January 31 complaint this constructs February 31. The comparison paragraph sets the escalation marker only when the check date is greater than that constructed date, delaying the option beyond the one-month maximum.

The source keeps the complaint day while advancing the month, producing February 31 for a January 31 complaint, and its greater-than check withholds the escalation marker until March 1. That delays the option beyond the clause's maximum.
